import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders_df = db["orders"]
    order_items_df = db["order_items"]
    reviews_df = db["reviews"]
    payments_df = db["payments"]

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # Только позиции, проданные не позже seed_time
    oi_hist = order_items_df[
        (order_items_df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) &
        (order_items_df["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    default_features = [
        "recency_days", "total_items_sold", "total_orders",
        "total_revenue", "total_freight", "avg_item_price",
        "days_since_first_purchase", "orders_per_day",
        "items_last_30d", "items_last_90d", "items_last_180d",
        "trend_30_90", "avg_freight_share",
        "avg_review_score", "total_reviews", "frac_5star",
        "frac_1star", "days_since_last_review", "avg_review_recency",
        "avg_payment_installments", "total_payment_value",
        "frac_credit_card", "frac_boleto",
        "frac_delivered", "frac_canceled", "frac_in_progress",
        "avg_delivery_days", "frac_late_deliveries",
        "has_historical_data"
    ]
    if oi_hist.empty:
        for col in default_features:
            result[col] = 0.0
        result["has_historical_data"] = 0.0
        result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
        for col in result.columns:
            result[col] = pd.to_numeric(result[col])
        return result

    order_ids_hist = oi_hist["order_id"].unique()

    # Заказы, созданные не позже seed_time
    orders_hist = orders_df[
        (orders_df["order_id"].isin(order_ids_hist)) &
        (orders_df["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже созданы к seed_time
    reviews_hist = reviews_df[
        (reviews_df["order_id"].isin(order_ids_hist)) &
        (reviews_df["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # Платежи: только известные к seed_time
    payments_hist = payments_df[
        (payments_df["order_id"].isin(order_ids_hist)) &
        (payments_df["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    order_product = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()

    # --------------------
    # 1. Order Items Features
    # --------------------
    oi_grouped = oi_hist.groupby("product_id")
    oi_features = pd.DataFrame(index=oi_grouped.size().index)

    last_purchase = oi_grouped["ts"].max()
    oi_features["recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days

    oi_features["total_items_sold"] = oi_grouped.size()
    oi_features["total_orders"] = oi_grouped["order_id"].nunique()
    oi_features["total_revenue"] = oi_grouped["price"].sum()
    oi_features["total_freight"] = oi_grouped["freight_value"].sum()
    oi_features["avg_item_price"] = oi_grouped["price"].mean()

    first_purchase = oi_grouped["ts"].min()
    oi_features["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days
    oi_features["orders_per_day"] = oi_features["total_orders"] / (oi_features["days_since_first_purchase"] + 1.0)

    oi_features["avg_freight_share"] = (oi_hist["freight_value"] /
                                        (oi_hist["price"] + 1e-6)).groupby(oi_hist["product_id"]).mean()

    # Скользящие окна продаж (только прошлое)
    for window, name in [(30, "items_last_30d"), (90, "items_last_90d"), (180, "items_last_180d")]:
        mask = oi_hist["ts"] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        oi_features[name] = oi_hist[mask].groupby("product_id").size()
        oi_features[name] = oi_features[name].reindex(oi_features.index).fillna(0)

    i30 = oi_features["items_last_30d"]
    i90 = oi_features["items_last_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    oi_features["trend_30_90"] = (i30 / i90).fillna(0.0)

    # --------------------
    # 2. Reviews Features (только отзывы, созданные до seed_time)
    # --------------------
    reviews_product = pd.merge(reviews_hist, order_product, on="order_id", how="inner")
    reviews_grouped = reviews_product.groupby("product_id")
    reviews_features = pd.DataFrame(index=oi_features.index)

    reviews_features["avg_review_score"] = reviews_grouped["review_score"].mean()
    reviews_features["total_reviews"] = reviews_grouped.size()
    reviews_features["frac_5star"] = reviews_grouped["review_score"].apply(
        lambda x: (x == 5).sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0)
    reviews_features["frac_1star"] = reviews_grouped["review_score"].apply(
        lambda x: (x == 1).sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0)

    last_review = reviews_grouped["review_creation_date"].max()
    reviews_features["days_since_last_review"] = (seed_time - last_review).dt.days
    reviews_features["avg_review_recency"] = reviews_grouped["review_creation_date"].apply(
        lambda x: (seed_time - x).dt.days.mean())

    # --------------------
    # 3. Payments Features (только известные платежи)
    # --------------------
    payments_product = pd.merge(payments_hist, order_product, on="order_id", how="inner")
    payments_product["is_credit_card"] = (payments_product["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(int)
    payments_product["is_boleto"] = (payments_product["payment_type"] == "boleto").astype(int)
    payments_grouped = payments_product.groupby("product_id")
    payments_features = pd.DataFrame(index=oi_features.index)

    payments_features["avg_payment_installments"] = payments_grouped["payment_installments"].mean()
    payments_features["total_payment_value"] = payments_grouped["payment_value"].sum()
    payments_features["frac_credit_card"] = payments_grouped["is_credit_card"].mean()
    payments_features["frac_boleto"] = payments_grouped["is_boleto"].mean()

    # --------------------
    # 4. Orders Features
    # Доставка учитывается только если заказ УЖЕ доставлен к seed_time,
    # иначе даты доставки были бы утечкой из будущего.
    # --------------------
    orders_product = pd.merge(orders_hist, order_product, on="order_id", how="inner")

    orders_product["is_delivered"] = (
        (orders_product["order_status"] == "delivered") &
        (orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()) &
        (orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    ).astype(int)
    orders_product["is_canceled"] = (orders_product["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"])).astype(int)
    orders_product["is_in_progress"] = (
        (~orders_product["order_status"].isin(["delivered", "canceled", "unavailable"]))
    ).astype(int)

    # Для расчёта сроков доставки берём только заказы, доставленные до seed_time
    delivered_mask = (
        orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() &
        (orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    )
    orders_product["delivery_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] - orders_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    orders_product["is_late"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (orders_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] >
         orders_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )

    orders_grouped = orders_product.groupby("product_id")
    orders_features = pd.DataFrame(index=oi_features.index)

    orders_features["frac_delivered"] = orders_grouped["is_delivered"].mean()
    orders_features["frac_canceled"] = orders_grouped["is_canceled"].mean()
    orders_features["frac_in_progress"] = orders_grouped["is_in_progress"].mean()
    orders_features["avg_delivery_days"] = orders_grouped["delivery_days"].mean()
    orders_features["frac_late_deliveries"] = orders_grouped["is_late"].mean()

    # --------------------
    # Combine
    # --------------------
    all_features = pd.concat(
        [oi_features, reviews_features, payments_features, orders_features],
        axis=1, join="outer"
    )

    result = result.join(all_features, how="left")

    result["has_historical_data"] = (~result["recency_days"].isna()).astype(float)

    fill_defaults = {
        "recency_days": 730.0,
        "total_items_sold": 0.0,
        "total_orders": 0.0,
        "total_revenue": 0.0,
        "total_freight": 0.0,
        "avg_item_price": 0.0,
        "days_since_first_purchase": 0.0,
        "orders_per_day": 0.0,
        "items_last_30d": 0.0,
        "items_last_90d": 0.0,
        "items_last_180d": 0.0,
        "trend_30_90": 0.0,
        "avg_freight_share": 0.0,
        "avg_review_score": 0.0,
        "total_reviews": 0.0,
        "frac_5star": 0.0,
        "frac_1star": 0.0,
        "days_since_last_review": 730.0,
        "avg_review_recency": 730.0,
        "avg_payment_installments": 0.0,
        "total_payment_value": 0.0,
        "frac_credit_card": 0.0,
        "frac_boleto": 0.0,
        "frac_delivered": 0.0,
        "frac_canceled": 0.0,
        "frac_in_progress": 0.0,
        "avg_delivery_days": 0.0,
        "frac_late_deliveries": 0.0,
        "has_historical_data": 0.0
    }
    result = result.fillna(fill_defaults)

    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    for col in result.columns:
        result[col] = pd.to_numeric(result[col])

    return result
